scope: All 180 model IDs returned by the production registry. Vendor means upstream model family/provider, not routing alias. Family identity does not independently certify a router alias or version's underlying checkpoint.
notes: Face/head swap operations are documented image endpoints; their underlying upstream vendor is not publicly identified and is explicitly Unverified.
Kling face recognition is a video preprocessing utility, not an LLM or a video generator.
Existing quoted prices remain unchanged; vendor/category labels are normalized when displaying old snapshots.
